description:
The Node.js version shows an [Extensions] section in the startup banner, listing active extensions like '@ollama/pi-web-search'. The Elixir version does not show this section.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
[Context]
  CLAUDE.md

[Skills]
  deep-research, work

(No Extensions section)

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
[Context]
  CLAUDE.md

[Skills]
  deep-research, work

[Extensions]
  @ollama/pi-web-search

The Extensions section should appear between [Skills] and the horizontal rule, listing any active extensions.
title: TUI-5: Missing Extensions section in startup banner
